name: Menahem
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, smote Shallum and reigned in his stead. Being king did not guarantee your life; your life was marked.
Shallum reigns a full month in Samaria before Menahem son of Gadi goes up from Tirzah, smites him, and reigns in his stead.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House

points: Menahem strikes Tiphsah and its coasts because they would not open to him, and he ripped up the women with child, a mark of his cruelty.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House

points: Menahem the son of Gadi reigned ten years in Samaria, exactly as the chart of the kings has it.
Menahem reigns ten years in Samaria and does evil, not departing from the sins of Jeroboam.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House

points: Pul the king of Assyria comes against the land, and Menahem gives him a thousand talents of silver to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House

points: Menahem raises the tribute by exacting fifty shekels of silver from each mighty man of wealth, so the king of Assyria turns back and does not stay in the land.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House

points: Pekahiah the son of Menahem reigned two years in Samaria, and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord. Surprise, surprise, evil again, departing not from the sins of Jeroboam.
Pekahiah son of Menahem reigns two years over Israel and does evil, not departing from the sins of Jeroboam.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House

cases.name: Menahem king of Israel
cases.charge: Ripping up all the women with child in Tiphsah; buying Assyria with a thousand talents of silver exacted from Israel
cases.preview: Menahem the son of Gadi killed Shallum, who had reigned a month, took the throne, and when Tiphsah would not open its gates he struck it and ripped open all its pregnant women (2 Kings 15:14-16).
